assets.caption: T-13 Thermowell — Flanged Thermowell Connection detail drawings showing NPS 3/4 & UP configurations with field make-up, weldolet, raised face weld neck flange, swage/reducer, and instrumentation piping callouts
assets.notes: Two detail drawings on the page showing T-13 thermowell flanged connection configurations. Upper drawing shows plan/elevation with horizontal run and two branch orientations. Lower drawing shows a smaller supplemental detail for NPS 6 line size and up. Annotations include NPS 1-1/2 raised face weld neck flange, NPS 1-1/2 weldolet, line size x NPS 6 swage/reducer, NPS 3/4 thru NPS 4 line size, field make-up, INSTR piping callouts, and dimension 300 (12) MIN.
